name: Advanced Senses Traits
body:
Rules Index | GM Screen

Advanced Senses Traits
Source Advanced Race Guide pg. 236
Scent (4 RP): Prerequisites: None; Benefit: Members of this race gain the scent ability (Bestiary 304).

See in Darkness (4 RP): Prerequisites: None; Benefit: Members of this race can see perfectly in darkness of any kind, including that created by spells such as deeper darkness.
